hookups.source: ReserveAmerica site details for every site (Electricity Hookup '50', Water Hookup 'Y' on all electric sites; e.g. https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=2630&parkId=552903) + the park notes on every site page ('There are no sewer hookups on any campsites. There is a dump station conveniently located near the entrance to the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The booking site lists 573 sites (the park page says 579): 358 with electric and water (50-amp in Loops C and F, 30-amp in B, E, G and H) and 215 without hookups (B, E, H and J). 24 pull-throughs; listed driveways run 23-136 ft, a handful in Loops B and C under 30 ft.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Poplar Point offers 579 sites for RV, tent and trailer camping; 363 sites have electric and water hookups') + ReserveAmerica site list and every Poplar Point site page, read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Showers, restrooms, trash containers, and a dump station are conveniently located'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2027: Loops C, E and F March 1 to November 1; B and G April 5 to September 7; H and J May 4 to September 7. 2026 was similar (C and F March 2 to November 2).

season.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area (Operating Season Schedule 2026 and 2027, Poplar Point Access camping loops), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop E is walk-up only, first come first served. Sites can be booked for today and up to 6 months ahead. Holiday weekends need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552903 (Booking Window, Campsite Electric / Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance'; Business Rules for Holiday Weekends: '2 nights Minimum Stay on holiday weekend', '1 night Minimum Stay on holiday weekend if the booking dates within 14 Days before Arrival Date') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/jordan-lake-state-recreation-area/camping ('Loops 3 and 4 at Parkers Creek and Loop E at Poplar Point are all walk-up campsites that are available on a first-come, first-served basis'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Sites without hookups $30 a night and electric/water sites $40, each including the $3-a-night service fee that the booking site adds to its $27 / $37 camping fee (charged on in-person bookings too). Seniors 62+, veterans and military members get $6 off a night with ID at check-in. No out-of-state rate; federal passes are not accepted. Cancelling costs $15 per reservation.

fees.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('RV with electric and water hookups $40'; 'Tent, trailer, or RV site with no hookups $30'; 'All prices listed on this website page include the $3 service fee'; 'A $3 service fee is charged for all reservations, including those made in-person'; 'Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass') + ReserveAmerica price breakdowns https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=1909&parkId=552903 (Loop B site B027, 2027-04-13: 'Camping Fees (1 night) $27.00 Per Night'), https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=1866&parkId=552903 (Loop B site B001, 2027-04-13: '$37.00 Per Night') and https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/jordan-lake-state-rec-area/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=NC&siteId=2630&parkId=552903 (Loop C site C004, 2027-03-16: '$37.00 Per Night') ('Reservation Fees $3.00 Per Night'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/about-us/state-parks-reservation-rates-and-activity-fees ('Seniors, veterans, and military members are eligible for a $6 discount per night on certain campsite reservations'; 'we do not accept federal passes, such as the America the Beautiful Pass, or passes for other states'), read 2026-10-22

summary: Added 50-amp (and 30-amp) electric and water with no sewer, 573 sites (358 electric) with 24 pull-throughs, showers and dump station, March-November season by loop, ReserveAmerica booking with walk-up Loop E (fcfs some_sites; 6-month window, holiday minimum waived within 14 days), $30 / $40 rates and the senior/military discount. AWH note kept.
